notes: Big look-and-feel update. Hoops: new animations for the jump shot (it holds at the set point while you hold SPACE and snaps into the release when you let go), layups, passes, pump fakes, step-backs, crossovers, steals and blocks; players run like athletes, slide on defence and dribble low when guarded. New Locker Room: number, jersey style, shorts, sneakers, socks, headband, wristbands, sleeves, tights and a win celebration. MMA: fighters move their heads, feint and keep rhythm between exchanges; a better uppercut and roundhouse. Fighter creator: new hairstyles, beards, eye colour, tattoos, shorts designs and glove trim. And the Octagon arena is rebuilt: LED ring, judges and commentary tables, VIP seats, TV cameras, a walkout arch, a lighting rig with beams and a big screen with the fighters' names.
